reason: World-to-Root floating-point transformation put top Skin x=10 vertices just below inclusive x>=10 window while bottom vertices remained included. The reported Skin top 0 and closure 0.17mm are extraction errors, not actual CAD geometry.
replacement_method: Intersect the actual mesh with the interior Root station x=12mm; retain all section vertices at the Rail edge.
qualification: No physical preload or joint qualification in either case.
